params.description: Canonical JSON object; callback keys are forbidden recursively; sessionId is fixed by the original run.

contract.throws: Original owner exceptions propagate; the adapter does not translate refusals.
contract.factory_contract: All owners share one SQLiteUoWFactory/authority; Records and BlobStore are composition-owned.
contract.effect: One fixed run/step/attempt reserves its original debit before one native RPC call; no retry.
contract.idempotency: Original run/step/attempt and immutable operation binding; unknown sends are not retried.
contract.completion_semantics: Outcome is only the original native RPC record status; engineering_completed is always false.
